description: Get the Product Hunt launches of the days you pick, one flat row per launch: name, tagline, daily rank, votes, comments, topics, maker names with their headlines, maker profile links, the product's website and company domain, and its X and LinkedIn links, plus one free summary row per day. Filter by topic, keyword, or minimum votes; only_new returns only launches an earlier run did not. Public pages are read through the Apify proxy with robots.txt obeyed; an optional Product Hunt developer token of your own reads the daily lists from the official API and adds unfeatured launches. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and is billed per launch row.

dates.description: Specific launch days as YYYY-MM-DD, up to 31.

days_back.description: The last N full days, in Product Hunt's day (Pacific time). 1 is yesterday. Default 1. Ignored when dates is set.

include_today.description: Also read today's list, which is still filling. Default false.

include_unfeatured.description: Needs product_hunt_token. Also return unfeatured launches. Default false.

keywords.description: Words to find in the launch name, tagline, or topics.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount.

min_votes.description: Keep launches with at least this many votes. Default 0.

only_new.description: Skip launches an earlier run with the same state_key returned (free). Default false.

open_product_pages.description: Read each product page for website, domain, makers, and socials. Default true.

product_hunt_token.description: Optional. Your own Product Hunt developer token, for the official API route. Never stored or logged.

state_key.description: Optional name for the only new launches memory.

topics.description: Product Hunt topics by name or slug, for example Artificial Intelligence, developer-tools.

name: get_product_hunt_launches
title: Get Product Hunt launches
